findings: Tail pair: predecessors of bb56.i, the post-sweep Result join (jne r7,2; bb.268 pre-BF). With the per-arm phi, greedy carries the accounts pointer (ctx+8, piece %1689, R5) across bb56.i->bb88->bb37. Nine preds reload it from [r10-2264]; three (bb16.i120, bb82.i152, bb93.i) use COPY r6.

The to_string.exit.i error pred falls into the reload block, and MBP puts chunk B (bb56.i..bb37 curve store, 88 blocks) before chunk A (main 0x2460-0x3bd0, 118 blocks).

MIR restore oracle (stop/start at branch-folder, exact round trip; 3 COPY r6 -> reload) restores main's layout exactly: M 2045/2047 vs 2247/2248 on ebe5387/e88f9d5. The -201 is in the sweep body (orig 0x2800-0x3c00).

Keeping the holder arg %0 live past the curve store (event is_holder_reward from and %0,1: e1) removes the r5 carry, so default llc gives main's layout, but M is 1993.

Frame-masked (tools/fm.py): e1 2508 vs main 2510; with frame and registers masked, 2790 vs 2787. e1's entire loss is spill-slot numbering: its holder slot -2304 shifts every later slot by 8. Main uses the original's holder slot -2384 (0x950) for a sweep clone-run r5 spill.
